exposure: fetal distress resulting from umbilical cord prolapse
outcome: Resident and nurse performance in managing fetal distress
cohort: OB/GYN and anesthesiology residents and nurses
finding: This simulation-based curriculum, designed to train residents and nurses in managing obstetrical emergencies, received positive feedback from participants, with over 90% rating it highly.
mod_finding: The abstract describes a simulation training scenario for medical professionals involving fetal distress and emergency cesarean section but does not present specific findings related to mode of delivery.
